notes.title: Pro Gymnast version 1.4.1 is now available!
notes.content:
Updates in this version:
[list]
[*] Added localized subtitles to the "how to swing" in-game tutorial video, and adjusted it's volume.
[*] Localized many strings that had been added in recent updates into all supported languages.
[*] Added an "extra flexible" option in the new "Physics Settings" section of the avatar creator.  This is for advanced players who want to simulate more complex, realistic Gymnastics moves.
[*] Added the ability to show/hide the wooden backing mounts on bars in custom levels
[*] Added an input to TOGGLE the focus slow-mo effect.  If you'd prefer to toggle this instead of just hold a button, you can use the "change control layout" to map this action to an input of your choice.
[*] Added a new bar prop in the editor that allows designers to adjust it's rigidity.
[*] retired the GRT Gym poster and features.  The location is still available for creating your own custom levels.
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: 1 Year Straddle & First Person Update
notes.content:
Let's celebrate 1 year of Pro Gymnast with a sale and a new update that adds the much-requested "straddle" pose, along with the vertigo-inducing (but surprisingly realistic) first-person camera view option.

Thanks to everyone who has supported the game so far!

notes.title: The Outfit Update
notes.content:
New in this update:
- New outfits! A simple competition outfit has been added that all players can use, along with a special discord member exclusive outfit.  join the discord to get it!
- New props: Logic AND and Logic NOT gates for your tricky level design needs.
- Grid backdrop lighting improvements.
- In-game news option to see what's new from inside the game.

notes.title: The Level Sharing Update is here!
notes.content:
It's our biggest update yet to Pro Gymnast!  It's now much easier to share custom levels with other players via Steam Workshop integration.  Try out levels created by other players from around the world, and share your creations as well.

This update also adds a few new props into the game to spark your creativity, as well as some other bug fixes and improvements, especially to the controller mapping system.

you can  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1214520/workshop/]browse the workshop levels here[/url]

notes.title: Pro Gymnast 1.0.6 now available
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed physics bug with the "tight grip" feature that meant the gymnast could get stuck on bars in some cases
[*] Gymnast points their toes during twists now
[*] In freeplay levels, the arm control is restored after sticking a landing, so you can do a "flourish" :)
[*] Started getting ready for more Steam features
[*] Fixed some translation and layout issues
[*] Fixed a bug where moving objects selection hitbox wasn't aligned properly in the editor after play-testing the level
[*] Added a player account using a technology called Playfab.  Currently it only creates the (anonymous) account, it's not used for anything.  This will pave the way for leaderboards or other social features in the future.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 is live
notes.content:
Third patch! fixes in this update:
- Big improvements to control mapping, allowing choosing the 'target joystick', and saving/loading mappings separately for different controllers.
- Added option to display game controller overlay on-screen during gameplay now (for streamers)
- Score overflow protection
- Resetting twist queue in various scenarios
- Fixed so that you can't go into multi-select when editing signals, and vice-versa now (in the level editor)
- Lighting improvements in the practice gym location

notes.title: Second patch is live!
notes.content:
Second patch for Pro Gymnast since launch, here are the fixes in this version:
[list]
[*] Added "active joystick" option to the game settings screen. If you have trouble with multiple connected joysticks, use this to only allow input from 1 specific joystick.  Setting to "all" enables all joysticks simultaneously, which is the default behavior.
[*] More details screen resolution options now, and overall should behave better when adjusting resolution.
[*] Fixed start position slightly on "Rope Traverse" levels
[*] Added gamepad input prompts to replay export screen, and improved layout and navigation slightly.
[/list]

notes.title: First patch is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!  Version 1.0.3 if Pro Gymnast is now live.  This patch is mostly minor but important fixes that should smooth out the experience of playing.  Full change list below:

[list]
[*] Score and Time medal requirement are now shown in the pause menu
[*] Improved "tuck and pike" tutorial to be much more reliable on detecting the poses
[*] Scrolling with the mouse wheel should feel better now!
[*] Improved the Audio/Visual settings, especially around game resolution, refresh rate, fullscreen.
[*] Replay export now supports exporting Square, 5:4, and Portrait HD aspect ratios (good for Instagram, etc!)
[*] Replay export now supports showing the timer and score as an overlay
[*] Changed the order of menu items in the Level Complete screen to be more logical
[*] Fixed keyboard prompts for some tutorials that were incorrect
[*] Fixed issues with input focus fighting between gamepad and mouse
[*] Re-arranged 2 levels in the training Pier location (content hasn't changed, just order)
[*] Fixed placement of the music speakers in the Gym location
[*] Updated the Japanese translation for "chalk" to be more authentic
[*] Gymnast feet now "flex" when approaching mats and other obstacles, so catching your toes should happen less.
[*] Moved the annoying mat on "Downhill Parallel Bars"
[/list]
